verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch6.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); UN M49 South-eastern Asia membership as listed in World Population Prospects 2024
verification.result: All 3,041 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; the UAE page uses 2024, the latest World Bank GDP year, and says so; unsupported comparisons (Thailand 'compared with its neighbours' without naming them, a too-short list of Thai deflation years) were corrected before publishing
